summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Stock Exchange rules, reporting routine share buybacks on the New York Stock Exchange. The filing details changes in issued shares and treasury shares, including a repurchase of 37,210 ADSs on June 5, 2026 at US$3.1072 per ADS (each representing three class A ordinary shares). No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review is present. This is a standard disclosure of an ongoing buyback program, not a special situation triggering a distinct category.
